connector.name: Peerlytics
connector.registryDescription: ZKP2P analytics on Base: live orderbook, route planning, explorer, and protocol market data.
connector.summary: Hosted at peerlytics.xyz over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace xyz.peerlytics, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: x-api-key
headers.description: Peerlytics API key (free tier at https://peerlytics.xyz/developers). Optional: without it, tool calls return 402 x402 payment requirements for pay-per-call.
